annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and majority voting accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8 with tick labels at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.3 to 0.6 in increments of 0.1. The plot contains four lines. The first line is dark blue, has circle markers, and is solid. It starts at approximately (1, 0.43) and ends around (256, 0.61), showing a generally increasing trend. The second line is green, features triangle markers, and is a dashed line. This line begins near (1, 0.42) and ends around (256, 0.6), indicating a consistent upward trend. The third line is light blue, uses circle markers, and has a solid style. It starts at about (1, 0.15) and ends close to (256, 0.45), with a gradual rise observable throughout the range. The fourth line is light green, features triangle markers, and is a dashed line. This line begins near (1, 0.15) and ends around (256, 0.45), indicating a consistent upward trend.
